name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
summary: Neeru Fireblade sends you to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas with herbs and word that he is satisfied with the shrunken head.

sections.title: The Herbs Go Back
sections.body: After A Strange Request, Neeru Fireblade gives you herbs for Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas. Take them to Uzer'i and tell him Neeru is satisfied with the shrunken head.

sections.title: The Ritual Begins
sections.body: Witch Doctor Uzer'i says the herbs are just what he needs to prepare the muisek vessel. He hopes his latest incantations prove as powerful as he expected. He asks you to wait while he performs the ritual and applies the herbs.

faq.q: Who gives the herbs to Witch Doctor Uzer'i?
faq.answer: Neeru Fireblade gives you the herbs after you bring him the shrunken head.

aliases: where do i take the herb pouch
faq.answer: The herbs go to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

faq.q: Was Neeru pleased with the shrunken head?
faq.answer: Yes. Neeru is satisfied with the shrunken head and asks you to tell Uzer'i.
